known_secrets.text: Multiple offices — temple, farm administration, and the record office — were reorganized at the same time, after the ash from Kalinga.
Specific individuals were deliberately struck from the civic rolls.
Some of the removed records correspond to physical structures that still exist.
This implies a deliberate break between memory and what's actually standing.
Partial maps of the village's layout before the restructuring survive.
These maps suggest additional routes into the areas near the old platform.
I have not shared these maps with anyone in current authority.
I have no trust in any single official account of the village's past.
